title: Nine Days of Cutting
subtitle: 奶酪与乳制品 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 奶酪与乳制品（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：奶酪与乳制品（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：cheese　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cheese 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to cut ① cheese she could not afford, and she said the cutting was the whole of the lesson. The ② cheese, meaning the wheel and not the milk, was nine days old and was cut by whoever came last; cheese, she said, is the only thing on a shelf that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cheese on that shelf had the same rind, and the ④ cheese at the end, meaning the one the maker kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever cut properly. Cheese, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cheese was the whole of the winter, meaning the store it carried and not the wheel. The ⑥ cheese, meaning the store and not any of that, is the only thing in a winter that everybody shares and nobody questions; cheese, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both a wheel and a store. She said the store is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ cheese had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the rind. The ⑧ cheese of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine days and eleven years of cutting; cheese, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cheese I remember is the one at the end, which was cut in 1974 and is still described as the sharpest in the county. A ⑩ cheese, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being cut; every cheese, she said, is a store that has agreed to look like a wheel. She said the store was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 奶酪（指那一整轮奶酪本身，与那些牛奶相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut a cheese 切一块奶酪
D. n. 奶酪（指架子上每一轮）
E. n. 奶酪（指末尾那一轮）
F. n. 储备（抽象：它承载的那份存粮）
G. n. 那份存粮（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The cheese, meaning the wheel and not the milk
cheese was the whole of the winter
the cheese had become a number in a report
The cheese of the whole thing
A cheese, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: cut a cheese 意为“切一块奶酪”，1954 年母亲被派去切她买不起的那块奶酪。
cheese 意为“奶酪、干酪”，指那一整轮奶酪本身而不是那些牛奶，放了九天，由最后来的人切。
cheese 指架子上每一轮奶酪，每一轮都是同样的外皮。
cheese 指末尾那一轮（制作人保留的那一轮），是唯一有人认真切过的。
cheese 意为“储备”，抽象指它承载的那份存粮，父亲说 cheese 就是那个冬天的全部。
cheese 为抽象用法，指那份存粮本身，是一个冬天里人人都分、却没人质疑的东西。
cheese 意为“奶酪、干酪”，到 1969 年这块 cheese 成了报告里的一个数字。
cheese 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九天和十一年的切割。
cheese 意为“奶酪”，我记得的是末尾那一轮，1974 年切开，至今仍被说成全县最冲的。
cheese 为抽象总称，祖母说一块奶酪是唯一会因为被认真切割而变好的东西。
